data.one_liner: Windows implementation of the video_player plugin using Media Foundation API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a lightweight video player implementation for Windows that leverages the built-in Windows Media Foundation API. It can be used alongside the video_player plugin to support Windows platforms with GPU hardware acceleration.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app for Windows that needs to play videos or audio.
You want to use the official video_player API while adding Windows desktop support.
avoid_when: You need to play HLS (.m3u8) streams.
You are targeting platforms other than Windows with this specific package alone.
strengths: GPU hardware acceleration with low CPU usage.
Small footprint with no third-party libraries inside and a single DLL file.
weaknesses: Relies on preloaded Windows codecs or requires external codec packs for certain media formats.
data.setup_notes: Add video_player and video_player_win to pubspec.yaml. May require administrator mode for building if MSB3073 occurs.

alternatives.name: media_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: A comprehensive media player for Flutter supporting more formats and platforms out of the box.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Focuses heavily on advanced audio playback features and playlist management.
